title: Decision artifact hub
purpose: Collect report, evidence and source links needed for decision playback.
behaviour: Collect report, evidence and source links needed for decision playback.
Render explicit empty, populated and read-only states.
Expose app/server interaction through callbacks or adapters rather than global state.
